<description>
Replace `time.time()` used to measure durations by `time.monotonic()` in test framework and http_interface.

This helps preventing future clock jump flakiness (same class of bug as #36529) on tests and fix:

```
faketime --exclude-monotonic -f "+0 x0.5" build/test/functional/feature_torcontrol.py
faketime --exclude-monotonic -f "+0 x0.1" build/test/functional/interface_http.py
```
</description>
